findings.message: Two duel players who both quit on the same tick through quitPlayer do not get spec 12's 'Cancel unresolved rewards if both forfeit on the same tick', and the outcome depends on the path. In packages/simulation/src/objectives/players.ts leave(), the first quit calls recordResult(win, opponent, forfeit). If the opponent has no eligible type, commitWin runs at once and moves PvP gold from the quitter to the opponent, and the opponent's same-tick quit cannot undo it. If a type is eligible, the opponent's same-tick quit settles through commitWin with the winner gone and nothing moves. Rubbings are never lost or duplicated, so this is gold and win-record only, but same-tick double quits should settle consistently, for example like a 'cancelled' outcome.
findings.requirement: §12 (the defeat and disconnect table and "Details that prevent exploits")

findings.message: freshRumors is a de-duplicated set that no operation ever clears (duels.ts commitWin: `player.freshRumors.includes(lost) ? player.freshRumors : [...]`). After a player's first loss of a type, a later loss of the same type leaves the state unchanged, so a future rumor system that reads this flag cannot see the new entitlement. Each loss should be recorded, for example as a counter or a list that gets consumed, or the ledger should offer a consume operation so a later loss sets the flag again.
findings.requirement: Every loss grants the loser a fresh-rumor entitlement for the lost type (a flag the rumor system will read later).

findings.message: Not every operation in the tests is followed by an invariant check. In ledger.test.ts, 'rounds gold down, caps it at 50...' chains addPlayer, addPlayer, reserveDuel and reportDuelResult and calls assertLedger only at the end. 'refuses a locked source...' calls addPlayer and startCollect on a raw state without checkLedger. The Run constructor applies unlockSource and addPlayer in a loop and asserts only once afterwards. The property test does check after every step. The gaps are small, but they do not meet the stated rule.
findings.requirement: A function checks the invariant (every id present exactly once, one location each, no player holding a type twice), and every test calls it after every operation.

findings.message: No check in this candidate proves that the new subpaths @pirate-sea-race/simulation/objectives and @pirate-sea-race/content/objectives load from dist/. The build log's postbuild smoke only covers content/moves and simulation/duel. decisions.md explicitly defers adding these subpaths to scripts/smoke-build.ts to the merge, so this is accepted, but it has to be done at merge.
